items.text: Navjot Singh Sidhu Becomes Grandfather: Baby Girl Gets A Special Sanskrit Name; Know What It Means
items.article: Navjot Singh Sidhu has become a grandfather as son Karan and daughter-in-law Inayat welcome baby girl Arya. But what does the little one’s beautiful name mean? CHANDIGARH: A joyous new chapter has begun in the family of former cricketer and The Great Indian Kapil Show fame Navjot Singh Sidhu. Sidhu has become a grandfather as his son Karan Sidhu and daughter-in-law Inayat welcomed a baby girl into their lives. Sidhu shared the happy news with his fans on social media, revealing that his granddaughter was born on October 1, 2026. He also announced her beautiful name: Arya Sidhu. Sharing a special poster on Instagram, Navjot Singh Sidhu announced the arrival of the newest member of the family. The news quickly spread across social media, with fans and celebrities showering the Sidhu family with congratulatory messages and blessings. A post shared by Navjot Singh Sidhu (@navjotsinghsidhu) The announcement also sparked curiosity about the meaning of the baby’s name. Arya is derived from the Sanskrit word “ arya “, which is associated with meanings such as noble, respectable and honoured. In Sanskrit and Hindu religious traditions, Arya is also used as an epithet associated with Goddess Parvati. For Sidhu, the arrival of his granddaughter marks a special family milestone, with the former cricketer sharing his happiness with his followers.

items.article: Ken Urker’s sister Autumn recalled her late brother’s last words to her before his death as she broke down via a TikTok Live Ken Urker ’s sister Autumn has shared the touching last words her brother said to her before his death . After news broke that Ken, who is Gypsy Rose Blanchard ’s ex-fiancé, had been found dead on his 34th birthday on Thursday, October 1, Autumn went live via her TikTok account . Autumn was visibly emotional throughout the live video, breaking down and sobbing uncontrollably. During the Live, Autumn confirmed that Ken had died. She also reflected on their last conversation, telling her followers that Ken’s last words to her were, “I love you.” However, it is unclear when this exchange took place. Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office confirmed Ken’s death, telling Us via a statement that they “responded to a residence” on Thursday “after receiving a call at 6:15 p.m.” Authorities confirmed Ken “was found dead upon arrival.” The LPSO added, “At this time, we are continuing the death investigation.”

items.key: ai:india formally names 28 places and features in ladakh on official map amid china push | why it matters
items.text: India formally names 28 places and features in Ladakh on official map amid China push | Why it matters
items.article: India has formally named and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on official Survey of India maps, following a similar exercise in Arunachal Pradesh. The move comes amid China’s practice of assigning Chinese names to locations in Indian territories. The Centre has formally identified and mapped 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh on the official Survey of India map, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) said on Friday. The MHA said the exercise was carried out in consultation with the Union Territory administration and is aimed at facilitating the “accurate recognition” of these locations and improving public awareness about them. The move comes after the Centre standardised the names of 27 places and geographical features in Arunachal Pradesh in August this year. The newly standardised names include Zorawar Peak, Kanishka Peak, Atisha Giri, Martand Giri, Rinchen Zangpo, Sakyasri Giri, Marpa Lotsava Ri, Milarepa Kangri, Shiva Ri and Maheshvara Ri. The list also includes Karun Pir, Drak Karpo and Jolmori mountains; Chapchingal Pass and Shachmirk Pass; Parpik and Skamri glaciers; and Shkorga Valley. Other identified geographical features include Brangsa, Kuksel, Dehra Compass, Gogra, Kumarayana Point, Panglung and Shamal Lungpa.
